title: Partial success recorded as total success — downstream consumer fails later
description: Activity creates file1.ts correctly and file2.ts malformed; task-level validation rules check file1.ts and pass. Activity posterior marks success. Days later, downstream activity that consumes file2.ts fails — but the cascade attribution mechanism blames the downstream activity, not the partial producer. Compounds FP-10 (cascade attribution) and FP-43 (attribution error).

preconditions: activity produces multiple output_impulse_ids in a single task
task validation rules only sample a subset of outputs
downstream activity exists that consumes the unsampled output

traces.synthesize: Walk composition_chain pairs (A→B) where A's success traces include output_impulse_ids the downstream B never successfully consumed within 24h of A's success.

goal_text: Audit recent successful executions whose output impulses were never consumed (or only partially consumed) by any downstream activity. Identify cases where the activity's output_shapes contract claims production of impulses that subsequent traces show were unusable. Propose an output-utilization validator activity.

detection.signal: Activity A's trace records success with output_impulse_ids=[I1, I2, I3]; but trace queries show no successful downstream activity ever consumed I2 or I3 within the next 7 days; AND impulse_relevance for (A, I2) and (A, I3) shows declining co-occurrence with successful downstream chains.
detection.query_template: SELECT activity_template_id, output_impulse_ids FROM activity_execution_traces a WHERE success = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_execution_traces b WHERE b.input_impulse_ids CONTAINS a.output_impulse_ids[1])
